system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I have a pending order for some boots. I'd like to change the size to 8, and I want to make sure they have the material option. I don't care if they're waterproof or not. Also, for any payment or refund, I prefer to use PayPal. Can you help me with that?

I can help with that — first I need to verify your account and get the order details.

Please provide either:
- your email address, or
- your first name, last name, and zip code.

Also please give the order id (it looks like “#W0000000”) for the boots order.

A few important notes before we proceed:
- You said you want the boots changed to size 8 and to have the material option (waterproof doesn’t matter). Do you want this change applied to every boot item in that order or only to a specific item(s)? If specific, please tell me which item(s) (item id or line).
- Modifying items on a pending order can only be done once and will change the order status to “pending (items modified).” After I locate your order I will check availability of the matching size/material variants and your payment methods.
- You requested PayPal for any payments or refunds — I can set PayPal as the payment method for the modification, but I’ll need to confirm the exact PayPal payment method id from your account before I make the change.
- After I pull up your order I will list the exact modification details (which item(s) will change to which new item ids, any price difference, and that PayPal will be used) and you must confirm “yes” before I perform the modification.

Please provide your email (or name + zip) and the order id and tell me whether to change all boot items or just specific ones.

I’d rather not give my email, but my name is Fatima Johnson and my zip code is 78712. I don’t have the order id handy right now—can you look it up with my name and zip? It’s just the boots order that’s still pending.

And yes, please apply the size 8 and material change to all boot items in that order. I want PayPal for any payment or refund.

Let me know what you find and what the next steps are.
